notes: Exact weighted Max-SAT over DIMACS-style WCNF with hard/soft clauses. Hard elements: a complete (branch-and-bound or MILP) encoding is mandatory since brute force is impossible at n=48 and heuristics give suboptimal totals; correct handling of tautological clauses, unit hard pins that permanently forfeit soft weight, jointly contradictory hard clauses (HARD_UNSAT), and comment/noise tolerance. Quantitative correctness is exact-match on the optimum; verifier re-executes the solver on three hidden instances with distinct structures (large satisfiable, hard-unsat, pinned).
